clusters.name: Transfer Order Notifications
clusters.reason: Enables push notification support in the Receiving App to alert users in real-time when new transfer orders are available for processing.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Discrepancy Tracking
clusters.reason: Enables the visibility and tracking of mis-shipped items added during transfer order receiving across the application history and reporting layers.

clusters.name: Proof of Delivery
clusters.reason: Introduces a new workflow to capture customer identity and confirmation at the time of order pickup, including a UI modal for signatures or ID uploads.

clusters.name: Ship to Store Fulfillment
clusters.reason: Implements an end-to-end journey for Ship-to-Store orders, including carrier restrictions, arrival tracking at the store, and automated handover communications.

clusters.name: Inventory Count Management
clusters.reason: A suite of updates for the Inventory Count App including discontinued product filtering, safety modals for scan removals, and batch hydration for product identifiers.

clusters.name: Shopify Data Reconciliation
clusters.reason: Automates the identification of discrepancies between Shopify orders and OMS records, generating clear reports to ensure data accuracy across platforms.

clusters.name: NetSuite Connector Data Feed
clusters.reason: Synchronizes transfer order items, receipts, and inventory variances with NetSuite while enforcing strict exclusion rules for non-synced orders.

clusters.name: Inventory Cost Calculation
clusters.reason: Refines the Weighted Average Cost (WAC) formula to handle negative QOH scenarios and returns, ensuring unit costs remain accurate during receiving transactions.

clusters.name: Facility Access Control
clusters.reason: Restricts store users to viewing and managing inventory data exclusively for the facilities they are associated with, enhancing system security and data privacy.

clusters.name: Kit Order Management
clusters.reason: Ensures accurate inventory deduction and shipment creation for multi-component kit products during POS sales and return restocks.

clusters.name: Embedded App Authentication
clusters.reason: Implements the login flow for Shopify Embedded Apps, allowing users to authenticate directly within the Shopify Admin and POS environments.

clusters.name: Digital Product Payment Capture
clusters.reason: Automates the creation of payment capture tags when the first physical or digital item in an order is completed.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Receipt Reconciliation
clusters.reason: Handles complex receiving scenarios like over-receiving and multi-shipment fulfillment by correctly splitting quantities across shipment receipt records.
